name: codex-our-free-model
description: Free frontier models inside Codex — no login, no sign-up, no API key. Adds a local Responses-API provider backed by the OpenCode Zen public free lane, and puts its models in Codex's own model picker.

interface.shortDescription: Free frontier models in Codex, with no account and no key.
interface.longDescription: Runs a local OpenCode Zen free-lane gateway that speaks the Responses API, and wires Codex to it as a custom model provider. A sidebar configuration app manages model visibility, API-key provider accounts, connection tests, and gateway setup. The model roster is pulled from the live lane, so models appear in Codex's own picker.
